themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, gather information, and make decisions with minimal human intervention.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, acting as collaborators in the software development process.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Details specific AI-powered platforms and software designed to aid researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for faster comprehension and insight extraction.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to analyze customer feedback, reviews, and social media to understand sentiment, identify trends, and gauge user opinions.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Covers AI applications that assist product managers in tasks such as market research, feature prioritization, and product development lifecycle management.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Focuses on AI-driven tools and platforms that enhance survey design, distribution, analysis, and the generation of actionable insights from survey data.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Highlights the application of AI in the early stages of design and research, including ideation, concept generation, and user experience exploration.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Details how AI is leveraged to extract deep understanding and actionable intelligence from customer data to inform business decisions.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated user profiles or data to simulate user behavior for testing, training, or research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
